answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing deters Sybil attacks through topological cut verifications and stake slashing. Graph auditing clusters agents into dense trust topologies; like a ripple spreading across a network, cross-cluster audits inspect bottlenecks. Honest nodes strike fraudulent clusters with falcon precision, slashing locked collateral upon forged attestations. Because Sybil nodes must post unrecoverable marble collateral for each forged edge, attacker cost scales superlinearly.
